tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search the All4Clinic help center (step-by-step guides in Brazilian Portuguese; English keywords like 'appointment' or 'inventory' work too) for how to do something in the system: scheduling, patients, medical records, quotes, finance, inventory, team, WhatsApp. Returns up to 3 guides with title, link and the most relevant passage. When a result includes panel_url, that is the screen in the clinic app (https://dash.all4clinic.com.br) where the person does the task: give them that link. Use read_help_article for the full guide.

query.description: What the person wants to do, in Portuguese or English keywords, e.g. "repetir agendamento", "cadastrar kit no estoque", "assinatura digital".

tools.name: read_help_article
tools.description: Read the full text of one All4Clinic help guide, given its link from search_help (e.g. https://ajuda.all4clinic.com.br/agenda/agendar). When the guide names the screen, the response includes panel_url: the link to open that screen in the clinic app.

url.description: The guide link returned by search_help.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List the All4Clinic subscription plans on sale: monthly price in BRL, highlights, what each plan includes and the link to sign up for it. Pass users and/or units (how many people use the system, how many branches) to get the cheapest plan that fits in 'recommended_plan'.

users.description: How many people will log in (doctors, reception, staff). Optional.

tools.name: find_meeting_times
tools.description: Find open times (Brasília time) for an online All4Clinic product presentation ("apresentacao", for clinics evaluating the system) or a team training session ("treinamento", for clinics already using it). Each time comes with a booking_url that opens the booking page with that day and time chosen; the person confirms there with their name, e-mail and WhatsApp. Nothing is booked by this tool.

type.description: "apresentacao" = product presentation for a clinic evaluating All4Clinic; "treinamento" = training for the team of a clinic that already uses it.

from.description: First day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the next available day.

tools.name: list_help_topics
tools.description: List every help-center guide grouped by area of the system (agenda, patients, medical records, finance, inventory, WhatsApp, fiscal, telemedicine...). Use it for "what can All4Clinic do?", "does it have X?" or to pick the right guide before read_help_article. Pass a section to see only its guides.

section.description: Optional area slug from a previous call, e.g. "agenda", "financeiro", "prontuario", "whatsapp".

tools.name: get_signup_info
tools.description: How a clinic starts with All4Clinic: free trial length, where to create the account (link with the chosen plan when given) and, once the account exists, the path to the first appointment step by step (first patient, first appointment, clinic phone, professionals' working hours, team, WhatsApp), each with where it is in the system and its guide link. Working hours do not hide free slots on the agenda. Use it also for "I created the account, now what?". Creates nothing: the person signs up and does each step in the system.

plan.description: Optional plan key from list_plans, to get the sign-up link already on that plan.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers from the All4Clinic website for the questions a clinic asks before buying: LGPD and data security, permissions and audit trail, several units and professionals, mobile and Windows apps, digital signature validity, how patients pay, what the AI does and does not do, migrating from another system and support. Optional query filters the answers (Portuguese or English keywords); without it returns all of them. For how-to steps inside the product use search_help.

query.description: Optional keywords, e.g. "LGPD", "aplicativo", "migrar", "suporte", "unidades". Empty returns every answer.
